assistant.title: Umujyanama
assistant.subtitle: Baza ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose ku buhinzi mu Kinyarwanda cyangwa mu Cyongereza.
assistant.welcome: Muraho! Ndi umujyanama wa IHUTE. Mbaza ku byonnyi, indwara, ifumbire cyangwa igihe cyo gutera.

answers.armyworm:
Nkongwa irya amababi y'ibigori bikiri bito igasiga imyanda imeze nk'ivu ry'ibiti.
• Reba ibimera 20 mu murima kabiri mu cyumweru.
• Mena amagi n'inyo nto ukoresheje intoki.
• Niba kimwe muri bitanu cyangiritse, baza umujyanama umuti wemewe.
answers.blight:
Ibibara byirabura bikwira ku mababi y'ibirayi nyuma y'imvura akenshi ni ububore (late blight).
• Kura amababi arwaye uyatabe.
• Ntukuhire ku mababi.
• Ohereza ifoto ukoresheje "Tanga ikibazo" umujyanama abyemeze akugire inama.
answers.fertilizer: Ku bigori, abahinzi benshi bakoresha DAP mu gutera na Urea iyo ibigori bigeze ku ivi. Ingano nyayo iterwa n'ubutaka bwawe; baza umujyanama cyangwa serivisi ya RAB yo gupima ubutaka.
answers.planting: Mu bice byinshi by'u Rwanda, ibishyimbo biterwa mu ntangiriro y'Igihembwe A (Nzeri) n'Igihembwe B (Gashyantare–Werurwe). Tera imvura imaze kugwa neza.
answers.fallback: Murakoze ku kibazo cyanyu. Nakigejeje ku mujyanama wo hafi yanyu ngo abahe igisubizo nyacyo. Ku gihingwa kirwaye, koresha "Tanga ikibazo" wongereho ifoto.
